findings.finding: CRITICAL F1 — Cross-language input_digest canonicalization divergence. adapter_contract §5a requires input_digest = sha256(canonical_json(state)||requested_model) computed IDENTICALLY on both sides. Python canonical_json (json.dumps sort_keys, separators) renders floats <1e-4 in exponent form (e.g. -8.779711216487518e-05) while TS canonicalJson (JSON.stringify) renders the same double as -0.00008779711216487518; exponent formatting also differs where both use exponents (Python '1e-07' vs JS '1e-7'). MEASURED at audit on the 25 real prepared request lines: 10/25 (40%) input_digests DIFFER between the Python and TypeScript implementations. At bulk, every such state's adapter response would be rejected by validate_response_line (input_digest_mismatch -> SCHEMA_ERROR -> TRANSITION_UNKNOWN) AFTER the billable call was made — silently converting ~40% of the bulk budget into forced-UNKNOWN decisions. Existing tests cannot catch it: all TS test vectors use values >= 1e-4. ACTION (before any live call, i.e. before bulk and ideally before STOP-1 GO): pin canonicalization to a single authority — e.g. quantize feature_vector to a fixed decimal grid in the payload before digesting on both sides, or have the request line carry the Python-computed input_digest and the adapter echo/compare it. Add a cross-language round-trip golden test with real-magnitude values (<1e-4).

HIGH F2 — prior_regime (f17) sequential dependency has no implemented bulk mechanism that satisfies both the one-call-per-state law and the §5a digest identity. f17 = persisted regime in force at t-1, which depends on prior decisions, which depend on the calls. The only implemented bulk-preparation path (run.py prepare-requests) walks the timeline with an empty/partial cache in non-strict mode, so request lines carry PROVISIONAL priors (measured: null then TRANSITION_UNKNOWN for the whole 25-line file). At scoring, sequential_timeline strict recomputes priors from the cache; wherever the true prior differs from the sent prior, input_digest mismatches and the cached (billable) decision is coerced to SCHEMA_ERROR -> TRANSITION_UNKNOWN — i.e. a naive batch bulk fail-closes to ~all-UNKNOWN. The alternative fixpoint loop (re-prepare after ingest, re-call changed states) is IMPOSSIBLE with the current store: DecisionStore/ingest-responses refuse any second line for an existing state_id (duplicate incident), so a changed-digest line can never be scored. The only correct design left is a strict sequential per-state loop (prepare 1 state -> call -> ingest -> persist -> next), which nothing implements or tests. ACTION (before bulk): implement + golden-test the sequential per-state replay loop (or an owner-approved equivalent) and demonstrate digest identity end-to-end on a mock pass.

findings.finding: HIGH F3 — Fold-gap trading violates the plan §2.4 embargo law ('positions never span boundaries'). Engine fold spans are a < ts_open <= b (engine.folds_from_regime_ts) over the frozen fold_contract boundaries, which are non-adjacent (BTC: fold1 end 09:00Z, fold2 start 10:00Z; SPY: end date d, next start date d+1(sessions), so each boundary leaves BTC 4 exec bars / SPY 1 session in NO fold; verified numerically on the frozen calendar: sessions 2018-07-02, 2021-03-26, 2023-12-19 belong to no fold). targets are computed for ALL exec bars without fold gating, and the engine can open a position from the fold-end bar's close signal into a gap bar (open of the next bar), which then spans into the next fold with no boundary event. PROVEN with an in-memory synthetic run at audit: trade entry_bar=11 (gap), exit_bar=25 (fold-1 end, reason fold_flat, fold_id=1); sum(fold_net_pnl) = -60.0601 != totals.net_pnl = -19.9600 — fold attribution does not reconcile with totals whenever gap trading occurs. Consequence: per-fold series (inputs to the concentration kill <=0.50, margin-to-fail P-2, DSR/PBO) silently omit or misattribute gap PnL. ACTION (before scored phase E; recommended before STOP-1): fold-gate the engine (no position may be opened or held on exec bars outside a fold; entry signal suppressed at fold-end bars; gap bars forced FLAT), and add a reconciliation assertion sum(fold_net_pnl) == totals.net_pnl to the runner.
